message: The aspect '{0}' cannot introduce the indexer '{1}' into the type '{2}' because the indexer has no parameter. An indexer must have at least one parameter.
rationale: In 'because it has no parameter', the pronoun can refer to the type '{2}' as well as to the indexer; the report site in IntroduceIndexerAdvice.ValidateBuilder checks the parameters of the indexer builder. The message also lacks the articles before 'indexer' and 'type'.
